title: otostegia fruticosa
intro: Otostegia fruticosa, commonly known as Desert Lavender, is a flowering plant native to the Middle East and North Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Otostegia fruticosa include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
